status: Signed integer Wire draft without a fixed flags field; Request/Response headers are 30/13 bytes. Incompatible with previous layouts containing flags. Optional client markers use opaque Metadata entries. HANDSHAKE=4, ACK=5, REJECT_DIRECTION=6 remain 17 bytes. Metadata valueLength:int8 (0..127). Canonical vectors covered by Java tests. PING=7 and PONG=8 are 5-byte physical-connection heartbeats with a positive int32 sequence. Positive error responses carry repeated int32 UTF-8 byte lengths and string bytes in the body; no arguments means an empty body. Error codes 1..1000 are reserved for RPC; business codes start at 1001. Positive unknown codes are preserved.
format: hex is a complete RPC frame without the 4-byte signed int32 TCP length prefix; tcpHex includes that prefix; all integers are signed big-endian
